notes.title: Bugfixes & New Drop List
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

Today we have a bit of changes to the game, some QoL (Quality Of Life) changes.

[h3][WellOfThePast][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added rarity color and name on the resulting bananas
[*] Fixes "Slender" Monkey issue - in some instances when going into the WellOfThePast it would flicker black and a monkey in it
[*] Added tooltips explaining what each section of the Well does, 1 for the Sage Monkey and 1 for the Wishing Well (it also states the %'s)
[*] Updates some animations
[*] Added option to trade 10k Normal bananas and 100k Normal Bananas into gold (to make it faster for bigger wales)
[/list]
[h3][Inventory/Exchange][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixes issue on Exchanging, in some cases it would not work, due to a conflict with Gold
[*] Fixes issue on not being able to remove selected items on Exchnaging
[*] Fixes issue on not being able to continuing to exchange after an error was thrown, something like "not enough normal bananas"
[*] Removes empty square (Gold) from the view
[/list]
[h3][Inventory/Item View][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixes issue on some descriptions would overflow
[*] Fixes issue on some buttons not aligning properly
[*] Adds magnifying glass on item view to view the full Selected banana skin
[*] Adds option to delete "Free Ultra Rare Christmas Token" and other similar tokens (asked by a lot of people)
[/list]
[h3][Inventory/Delete Item][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixes issue on not being able to delete items
[*] Fixes issue on the popup message not being able to close
[/list]
[h3][Builders][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixes some issues with visualization of some tooltips
[/list]
[h3][Settings][/h3]
[list]
[*] Adds separate volume bars for SFX, Music & Master
[/list]
[h3][Main Menu / [b]NEW [/b]Drop List][/h3]
[list]
[*] Adds new Drop List in-game(inside the phone) Note: if you hover each banana it'll tell you what's their % of dropping
[/list]
[h3][Main Menu / READDED Event Exchange][/h3]
[list]
[*] Re-enabled the event exchange
[/list]
[h3][Skins][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixes issue on, again, Helicopternana being swapped with Submarinenana
[/list]

- The Banana Team

notes.title: Christmas Update & Upcoming Sneak Peek
notes.notes:
[h2]Happy Holidays Everyone![/h2]

For this years Holidays and Christmas event we have changed the in game theme to fit the winter vibe.

We are also introducing a new system which we would like [b]YOUR[/b] feedback on for future like wise events.

[h3]Introducing: the event exchange system![/h3]

First of all [b]EVERYONE[/b] gets a free Ultra Rare token this [i][b]can not be traded or sold[/b][/i] and are to be used in the exchange.

The tokens you buy from the item shop are [i][u][b]tradeable and marketable[/b][/u][/i].

When launching the game you will see a new button in the top right next to the others called Event Exchange.

If you click this button a new menu will open where you will receive two options:
[list]
[*] Option A: Ultra Rare Exchange
[*] Option B: Legendary Exchange
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970814/92aa354e22daa22afd605ad2fc739d39f712c9f6.png[/img]

[h3]Option A:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Costs 350 Normal bananas and 1 Ultra Rare Token
[*] Gets you the Ultra Rare Christmas Treenana
[*] 1 Ultra Rare token can be bought from the item store
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970814/d9f9fb55b02842396346e68ceafa27d65a1cea64.png[/img]

[h3]Option B:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Costs 3500 Normal bananas and 1 Legendary Token
[*] Gets you the Legendary Christmas Bananachan
[*] Legendary token can be bought from the item store
[/list]

You are [b]NOT ABLE[/b] to get these any other way.

notes.title: QoL Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Bananas![/h3]

[h3]QoL Changes[/h3]
Today we have some changes regarding QoL (Quality Of Life) changes. That makes it easier to spot different types of bananas inside the game, search and filter them out as well. (The filter does not save between game sessions)

Oh and we've updated the game to reduce the storage usage! (Unninstalling & installing is recommended!)

[h3]Normal Bananas - The Huge Quantity[/h3]

So, we've been seeing, for a while, that the normal banana quantity is still increasing, really fast.
So, we're gonna give it another purpose within the game to make it useful and clean some inventories.
(BTW! There's a [i][b]delete button[/b][/i] if you think you have too many of any banana, you can delete them from your inventory!)

notes.title: Banana Drop Pool Update & Answering a Stacking Question
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Bananas![/h2]

Before we release more Autumn 2024 Collection bananas we're updating the drop chance for the bananas.

[h3]Why?[/h3]
[b]A:[/b] From our calculations, if we kept the same drop chances, it would increase the higher rarity bananas' number, which would decrease their actual value. The more there are the less value they have, and that's the opposite of what we want.

[h3]Why only now?[/h3]
[b]A:[/b] Only now we have an idea of the number of bananas that can be created and we have more statistics on what can happen. And with the exchange system, it will go down more smoothly in terms of bananas not circulating (being exchange into higher rarities).

[h3]So here are the new drop chances![/h3]
([b][color=#FF474D]Old[/color][/b] [b][color=orange]>[/color][/b] [b][color=lightgreen]New[/color][/b])
[list]
[*] Normal - [b][color=#FF474D]54%[/color][/b] [b][color=orange]>[/color][/b] [b][color=lightgreen]70%[/color][/b]
[*] Common - [b][color=#FF474D]30%[/color][/b] [b][color=orange]>[/color][/b] [b][color=lightgreen]25%[/color][/b]
[*] Uncommon - [b][color=#FF474D]10%[/color][/b] [b][color=orange]>[/color][/b] [b][color=lightgreen]4.89%[/color][/b]
[*] Rare - [b][color=#FF474D]4%[/color][/b] [b][color=orange]>[/color][/b] [b][color=lightgreen]0.1%[/color][/b]
[*] Epic - [b][color=#FF474D]2%[/color][/b] [b][color=orange]>[/color][/b] [b][color=lightgreen]0.01%[/color][/b]
[*] Ultra Rare - [b][color=#FF474D]1 in 4 000 000[/color][/b] [b][color=orange]>[/color][/b] [b][color=lightgreen]1 in 400 000[/color][/b]
[*] Legendary - [b][color=#FF474D]1 in 28 000 000[/color][/b] [b][color=orange]>[/color][/b] [b][color=lightgreen]1 in 10 000 000[/color][/b]
[/list]

[h3]What stacking question?[/h3]

We noticed there's been some confusion with the exchange system and exchanged bananas, so we'll try to clear it up as much as possible - sorry if it’s caused any confusion!

[list]
[*] Any banana you get from the exchange system will have the "Origin Exchanged" tag.
[*] Whether you use exchanged or dropped bananas, the result will always be an "Exchanged" banana. 
[/list]
Pretty straightforward, right?

Now, a few of you pointed out that exchanged bananas aren’t stacking with dropped bananas.
We’re working on a way to visually show the difference between dropped and exchanged bananas. Here’s why that matters:

[list]
[*] Some people have spent serious cash on their dropped bananas, and now the same ones can pop up from exchanges
[*] We want to make sure that if you own a dropped banana, you can still flex your original, earned version.
[/list]

(There's gonna be a visual difference that will not impact how the banana itself looks, more so as a colored symbol/text in the tags section when you hover over the banana in the market that kind of "jumps" in your sight so you really can't miss it and also in-game and inventory there will be this slight visual indicator)

- The Banana Team

notes.title: Drop Pool Update!
notes.notes:
Hello @Bananas

We've made an update to the drop system!

Previously we had 2 drop pools, where in 1 of them you could only get commons or normals, called the "Common Drop Pool".
And one of the you could get a rare with a chance of a higher rarity banana, called the "Rare Drop Pool".

BUT, since the "rare" drop pool wasn't actually "rare", everyone would either get one or a ultra rare or legendary, we've updated the drop system to ACTUALLY use %'s but, in 1 drop pool only!

So, the NEWLY UPDATED DROP POOL with PERCENTAGES WOO!

Removed 18 hour drop pool

Updated 3 hour drop pool to the following*:
[list]
[*]58% Normal
[*]34% Common
[*]8% or to be exact 7.999999714285% ~ Rare
[*]1/4 000 000 Ultra Rare
[*]1/28 000 000 Legendary
[/list]

Good luck! :wink:

* Subject to change
